insertText.text: Can a robot execute a familiar task in an unseen situation?

Learn how to grasp and move
across variations of the same task.

Estimate current conditions
to guide the policy’s actions.
Our setup: RL with environmental context
Train a pick-and-lift policy with standard state and selected environmental parameters.
Known in training; estimated at test
Training: learn the weights.  Testing: freeze the policy.
Result 1: a controlled initial mass estimate
An image-only estimator learns the size-to-mass relationship under fixed density.
Fixed material, density, friction and camera; held-out sizes test interpolation.
Result 2: the estimator and policy are connected
Three configured simulation trials ended with a grasped object at the target.
One start per size, 50 actions per trial. This is not a reliability estimate.
